newsitem.title: USA: Inter-Regional names CEO of Dain unit.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Regional names CEO of Dain unit.

text.p: Inter-Regional Financial Group Inc said Tuesday it named John Appel, who has been president and chief operating officer of its Dain Bosworth unit since 1994, as chief executive officer of Dain.

He succeeds Irving Weiser, who continues as chairman of Dain Bosworth and also Inter-Regional's Rauscher Pierce Refsnes unit. In addition, Weiser is chairman and chief executive of Inter-Regional Financial.
In addition to his post at Dain, Appel is executive vice president of Inter-Regional Financial and a member of the company's board of directors.
Appel joined Inter-Regional Financial as senior vice president and chief financial officer in 1986.
